721330101.text: Hello! Excuse me, outlander. Could you hear me out?

721330103.text: Please don't linger on this island for too long. Recently, the Tatarigami's reach has spread wider and wider.

721330105.text: Yes, since the people from Sangonomiya destroyed the ward that suppressed the soul of the serpent god, the Tatarigami has spread across the island...

721330106.text: As you can see, the sky is now perpetually clouded and the rain won't stop. This is all because of the Tatarigami.

721330107.text: Recently, one by one all the miners have fallen ill, gone insane, or fled to other islands...

721330108.text: Everyone's gone. There's hardly anyone living on this island anymore.

721330109.text: Ironically, due to the chaos created by the Tatarigami, the Shogunate and the rebels have not been fighting over this place quite as hard.

721330110.text: Hmph! But if they had not destroyed our great Ogosho's ward, the island wouldn't have become such a mess in the first place!

721330111.text: What do the Commissions or dragons or serpents have to do with me, huh? They never asked my opinion before starting their cursed war!

721330112.text: Then why are you still here?

721330113.text: Why? Because this is my home.

721330115.text: They are in a safe place, but thanks for your concern. They must be waiting for me to bring them back here.

721330116.text: No one on the island left voluntarily. We are a family here. Anywhere else we go, we'll have to work for someone else.

721330117.text: But someone had to stay and clean up the mess so that everyone else can return home eventually.

721330119.text: Is there anything I can help with?

721330120.text: If it were any other child offering to help me out of the blue, I'd be laughing out loud right now...

721330121.text: But seeing as you're a traveler from afar who has managed to venture this deep into Inazuma, you must certainly be able to hold your own.

721330122.text: I'll get straight to the point, then. The ward over there has been bothering me for a long time, maybe you could find a way to repair it?

721330123.text: I'm sure that this awful weather can only be due to the wards' destruction.

721330124.text: But please, be careful when you approach the ward. If you stare at it, it will release a burst of energy towards you...

721330125.text: It's harmless, but very uncomfortable. It feels like it's... rejecting you.

721330126.text: I think the ward is missing some components. It can probably be fixed by putting the missing parts back.

721330127.text: Of course, that's just speculation on my part. I still can't say for sure what's gone wrong.

721330128.text: So, if you want to help, please help me fix this ward.

721330129.text: But if you can't manage it, then like I was saying — don't stick around here too long.
